note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straightened front photo (38 mm case, owner's spec sheet); heights are the house SNKL41K1/SNKL47K1 values (no orthographic side view). All steel: polished case, lugs, indices, numerals, hands and crown, brushed bracelet with polished bevels. SEIKO, the 5 shield, the applied 12 9 6, the print, the minute track and the day and date windows stay in the dial map.

case.note: bezel slope from the photo: grey inner slope 15.9-16.8 mm, polished band to the 19 mm edge

dial.note: black dial to 14.77 mm, then the silver rehaut slope (both from the photo map)

bracelet.columns_note: [x0, x1 as a fraction of the half width, material]: wide centre column from the notch in the hood, outer links from the lug tips (photo: half a row apart)
bracelet.bend_note: Smooth curl (house, from SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, end_y = tip + 2.2 R, links bend with the curve

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

lume.note: white lume strip as photographed in daylight (jamtangan.com lume shot: it glows on both hands and the index ends)

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL downscaled to 1K (keeps the GLB under 10 MB); lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material
